answer.reason: The verses tell of his evil reign and his killing in the palace by Pekah, which add to the summary.

clauses.english: did evil in the sight of the LORD and did not depart from the sins of Jeroboam
clauses.quote: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat

clauses.english: was killed in the palace at Samaria by Pekah, who conspired against him
clauses.quote: conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria, in the palace of the king's house
